title: Commanders coach Dan Quinn and QB Jayden Daniels both accept responsibility for time management gaffe in tie vs. Giants

sources.title: Commanders coach Dan Quinn and QB Jayden Daniels both accept responsibility for time management gaffe in tie vs. Giants
